notes.title: Update: 15.06.2025
notes.notes:
✨ Added

[list]
[*] 🧟‍♂️ New jump scares
[*] 📱 Helper UI that shows the inputs for the phone
[*] 👓 Tutorial on how to use the glasses (camera)
[/list]
🔧 Updated
[list]
[*] 🧍‍♂️ Human body poster is now more detailed to help solve the puzzle faster
[*] 🚪 Some doors have been blocked to reduce confusion
[*] 💡 Lighting added to directional signs for better visibility
[*] ⌚ Dispatcher message now mentions the beeping sound of the watch
[*] ⚠️ Monitor warning text has been updated
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Added: Confirmation prompt when interacting with the electricity box.

Added: Lighting to directional signs for better visibility.

Added: New menu setting to adjust sensitivity for door opening interactions.

Added: Whispers to collectable items (final task)

Fixed: Material moving unexpectedly on a photo – it now remains correctly attached.

Fixed: Two floating small objects in the locker room security area have been removed.

Fixed: Bug with the padlock – holding to drag and pressing E to exit no longer causes it to get stuck.

Fixed: Bug related to Door 8 functionality.

notes.title: Major Bugs Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed 2 major bugs.
[list]
[*] Sending a photo of a human body to the dispatcher resulted in: "There is nothing important."
[*] Starting a new game after already playing one would show all the old photos on your phone.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the drawer to be dragged through walls
[*] Added new text to the security note to help players find the 5-digit code more easily
[*] Fixed a bug related to saving/loading from the menu
[*] Added numbers to cables in the breaker puzzle
[*] Updated the description of "A key"
[/list]

notes.title: The Nightmare Begins – Our Horror Game is Officially Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620994/82b5d2ba951625c23073694ecc945a3ed56d122a.png[/img]

After countless nights of development, testing, and terrifying ideas brought to life, we're beyond thrilled (and slightly scared) to announce that our horror game is now LIVE! 🎉

🕯️[b]This isn’t just a game — it’s a descent into madness. 🕳️[/b]
You’ll explore an abandoned asylum, encounter unspeakable horrors, and piece together a story that may haunt you long after the screen fades to black.


🔪 [b]What to expect:[/b]

[list]
[*] Immersive atmosphere and unsettling environments
[*] Dynamic audio design that reacts to your every move
[*] A story full of mystery, fear, and hidden truths
[*] Survival mechanics that keep you on edge
[/list]

💬 Tell us what you think, share your gameplay, and let us know what scared you the most!
🐛 Found a bug or glitch? Report it and help us make the experience even better.

Thank you for joining us on this journey into fear.
This is just the beginning — the real nightmare starts now.
